external-contracting.title: External master review
external-contracting.description: Prepare the final plan packet, confirm model and effort, request review, ingest the share link, and evaluate the return before architect adjudication. A review recommendation is not implementation authority.

local-workers.title: Local review workflow
local-workers.description: Ask the coach, explicitly opt into local inference, select the configured profile, then evaluate the return. The architect—not the worker—decides what to accept.

contractor-demo.title: Historical contractor demo
contractor-demo.description: Historical demo: Beads work lanes led to a bounded packet, a contractor branch, return review, and an accepted publication. This record does not authorize a new dispatch or publication.

beads-memory.title: What persists between sessions
beads-memory.description: Session A saves project files and tests alongside task decisions. A fresh Session B reads both and verifies them before continuing; an unrecorded conversation is not part of that durable state. The two branches show saved information, not concurrent workers.

model-synthesis.title: Review and synthesis
model-synthesis.description: The architect plans the work; isolated review lanes return evidence. Evaluate each return before synthesis, then let the architect adjudicate agreement and conflict.

zero-trust-consensus.title: Evidence before consensus
zero-trust-consensus.description: Evaluate returns, group their trust domains, compare structured claims, and report agreement and divergence before architect adjudication. Agreement alone does not establish correctness.

malpractice-sabotage.title: Return safety gate
malpractice-sabotage.description: Check the return against its packet and mutation boundary, score malpractice and sabotage signals, and record an accepted, rejected, or quarantined disposition. The architect decides whether a finding may change the plan.

codex-beads-hooks.title: Hook display decision
codex-beads-hooks.description: When SessionStart context is visible, inspect the installed Codex build. If the stable display hint is supported, quiet display is available; otherwise retain full-context display. Both paths preserve Beads additionalContext. Unsupported quiet mode fails closed.

task-acceptance.title: From need to accepted work
task-acceptance.description: Define the need, acceptance criteria and scope; save the work record and dependencies; permit bounded execution; check the evidence; save the owner’s decision and handoff before selecting the next ready task.
